text:
Hii everyone!
I received recently my A5 visa with my sefach (30/08). Went to bituach leumi on sunday 6th and filled out the toshavut tofes. Today I’ve got a call from them saying that I can now register myself in a kupat holim. The question is, as long as I still don’t have my TZ (the plastic one), is there any chance that I could register myself without it? And secondly, how long does it take to get a TZ? 

Cause I’ve got a job proposal and they are asking me to give them my kupat holim number. So I’m in a bit hurry situation. 

Thanks!!
